content.short: Tangem is a simple cold Bitcoin wallet where you can buy, sell, and store Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other crypto assets.
content.description: Tangem is a hardware wallet provider that offers NFC-powered cold wallets for storing Cardano ADA, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other crypto assets. Its cards are fully non-custodial, so users keep control of their private keys without relying on a company, bank, or exchange. The wallet works through a phone's NFC module, removing the need for batteries, cables, or Bluetooth connections. Tangem is designed for long-term asset protection while still giving users a simple mobile interface for everyday wallet management across many blockchain networks.
content.meta: Tangem is an NFC-powered hardware wallet for non-custodial Cardano ADA and multi-chain crypto storage. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
